answer:
I've turned your Porto weekend note into a trip page. You'll find it under the Page switch on the note.

- **Countdown:** it shows the days left until Friday 16 Oct. That's 11 days from today.
- **Flights and hotel:** two cards at a glance. Flights show the outbound and return with times and flight numbers. The hotel card shows Casa do Conto with the address, confirmation number and check-in time.
- **Budget:** your ~6000 kr sits in its own card below the lists.
- **Ideas and to-dos:** each is a tickable list with a progress count. Ticking an item on the page updates the note.

Your ideas were plain bullets, so I changed them to `- [ ]` checklist lines in the note so they can be ticked. The wording is the same.

The page reads the flight, hotel and budget lines straight from the note, so edits to those lines show up on the page. This only works if you keep the "flights:", "hotel:" and "budget" line formats.
